sections.title: What this module covers
sections.body: Active Record associations are a mandatory topic in every Rails interview, and the questions range from basic (what's the difference between belongs_to and has_many) to design-level (when to use has_many :through vs has_and_belongs_to_many, and why through is almost always right). This page covers the full association toolkit: belongs_to (required by default in Rails 5+), has_many, has_one, has_many :through (and why it's always preferable to HABTM — you can always add columns to the join table later), polymorphic associations with as: and source_type:, self-referential associations, and the dependent: options (:destroy vs :nullify vs :restrict_with_error). The inverse_of option appears in scenario questions about validation failures with unsaved associations.

sections.title: Key topics and depth markers
sections.body: Topics: has-many-belongs-to, through-associations, polymorphic-associations, dependent-options. Each topic has dedicated Q&A covering the concept, the comparison, the internal mechanics, and the scenario-based questions interviewers use to test production understanding.

sections.title: How interviewers probe this module
sections.body: Interviewers at Rails-focused companies probe these topics by opening with a definition question, then immediately following up with when would you use X vs Y? and what are the gotchas?. The depth marker is always the trade-off and the failure mode — not just the API surface.
